run_convert_puzzles_to_pddl: run convert_all_puzzles_to_pddl to convert PushWorld puzzles into PDDL domain and problem files
build_pddl_conversion_cli: build a CLI tool using fire.Fire to convert PushWorld puzzle files into PDDL format
test_convert_all_puzzles: test convert_all_puzzles_to_pddl with a given puzzle_path and pddl_path output directory
run_convert_for_bfws: run convert_all_puzzles_to_pddl with for_bfws=True to reduce predicate arity for BFWS planner compatibility
review_convert_all_puzzles: review convert_all_puzzles_to_pddl to convert all PushWorld puzzles in a directory recursively into PDDL files
